subject: Fitted furnishings and two-sided broad leaves in the Plan Reveal samples
renderer: Chromium (Playwright) with software WebGL 2 (ANGLE SwiftShader), walk mode at a fixed pose after indoor exposure and the room's light probe settle
before: The pages as committed before this change (334190c): examples/gallery/aangan-house and long-house preview.html and reveal.html
after: The same pages republished by scripts/build_plan_reveal_samples.py with furnishingStyle "fitted" and the rebuilt viewer
shots: scripts/capture_furnishing_closeups.mjs derives the close-ups from each page's scene: every bed from beyond its foot corners, along a long edge and at its head; every potted monstera from eye height and from below; every default kitchen run square on and from either end

beds.jpg.shows: Before: the spread's edge cuts through the mattress's rounded shoulders (jagged, torn-looking edges and pale slits of mattress) and its corners stand stiffly past the foot. After: one closed quilt, 20 mm inside the mattress edge, with rounded corners.

kitchen.jpg.shows: Before: a vessel bowl standing on the worktop, plain wall units running over the hob with no hood or handles. After: a stainless sink let into the worktop, a chimney hood over the hob with its duct to the ceiling, and wall cupboards beside the hood, each door with a bar handle.

house-plants.jpg.shows: Before: monstera undersides and tips curling away from the eye take a pale, sky-coloured or cream sheen. After: both faces read the same green.

walkthrough.jpg.shows: Plan Reveal stills at the dwell of the kitchen and bedroom stops (window.__planReveal.still at 0.6 of each dwell), before and after.
